reviews.title: Ok but
reviews.text: Waplog feels misleading and frustrating to use. The app pushes you to earn or buy points just to message someone, which isn’t clearly explained upfront. You might match or find someone interesting, only to discover you can’t even send a simple message without spending points. It starts to feel more like a paywall than a dating app. Instead of focusing on real connections, the app focuses heavily on monetization, which takes away from the overall experience. Not recommended if you’re looking for genuine, straightforward communication without constant prompts to pay

reviews.title: Scam Users
reviews.text:
There are women on this app that will ask you to chat off the app to be more "intimate" with you.
As most people should know this is not always the best idea. However, they will take your photos and try to bribe you into giving them money or they will collage your photos and try to make them go "viral". The problem with this is that they can just take any random photos and collage them together and bribe anyone. So, it's not the smartest scam, but it's sad that it had to come down to that. Why aren't we allowed to be "intimate" within the app itself? Why is it so restrictive? We're only human. And sometimes humans need love.
